render.prompt:
Image 1 is a real phone photo of a room to edit. Image 2 is a placement guide: the same photo with numbered translucent boxes showing where each product goes; use it only for position and scale and never draw its boxes or numbers. Images 3 to 7 are the reference photos of products 1 to 5, in order.
1. Add product 1: Beige Linen Loveseat Sofa (sofa), real size 170.2 x 96.5 x 88.9 cm (width x depth x height). Centered against the left wall with back to wall facing into room. It belongs inside box 1 of the placement guide. Copy product 1 exactly from its reference photo: Rectangular two-seat loveseat in beige linen with thick loose cushions, low square arms and tapered dark wood legs. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
2. Add product 2: Cream geometric criss-cross rug (rug), real size 182.9 x 121.9 x 1.3 cm (width x depth x height). Laid on wood floor centered in front of sofa leaving walkway clear. It belongs inside box 2 of the placement guide. Copy product 2 exactly from its reference photo: Rectangular low-pile area rug in cream with subtle raised criss-cross geometric weave and soft woven wool texture. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
3. Add product 3: White Tripod Shelf Floor Lamp (floor lamp), real size 40.6 x 40.6 x 147.3 cm (width x depth x height). Stands on floor in far corner by window at end of sofa. It belongs inside box 3 of the placement guide. Copy product 3 exactly from its reference photo: White tripod floor lamp with round fabric drum shade, central pole, circular light wood tray table and slender splayed legs. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
4. Add product 4: Round Tray Coffee Table (coffee table), real size 101.5 x 99 x 47 cm (width x depth x height). Placed on rug parallel in front of sofa with space to walk around. It belongs inside box 4 of the placement guide. Copy product 4 exactly from its reference photo: Low round tray-top coffee table with raised rim and four curved Y-shaped wooden legs in warm medium walnut brown finish. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
5. Add product 5: White Cylindrical Planter with Stand (planter), real size 43.9 x 43.9 x 49.2 cm (width x depth x height). Sits on floor under right side of window away from walkway. It belongs inside box 5 of the placement guide. Copy product 5 exactly from its reference photo: Tall cylindrical off-white ceramic planter pot supported by a four-legged dark walnut wood stand with vertical dowels. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
Remove: cardboard box front; cardboard box back; rolled mat. Show the floor and wall that were behind them, continuing the surrounding texture, so it looks like they were never there.
Hard rules: keep the exact same camera position, framing, lens distortion and perspective. Keep the walls, wallpaper, floor, ceiling, ceiling light, windows, blinds or curtains, doors and every object that is not listed exactly as they are. Keep the existing light direction, color temperature and exposure; new products receive the same light and cast soft, physically plausible contact shadows. The result must look like an unedited phone photo of the same room, not a render. Do not add anything else: no extra decor, no text, no numbers, no colored boxes or outlines.
